build_mask_feature_module: build a MaskFeatModule to extract unified mask feature maps from multi-level FPN features for SOLOv2 instance segmentation
build_solov2_head: build a SOLOV2Head with dynamic convolution kernels for fast instance segmentation on multi-scale feature maps
run_forward_solov2_head: run the SOLOV2Head forward pass to produce kernel predictions, classification scores, and mask features from input features
run_loss_by_feat: run loss_by_feat to compute dice mask loss and focal classification loss from kernel and classification predictions against ground truth
run_predict_by_feat: run predict_by_feat to generate instance segmentation masks with scores and labels using dynamic convolution and mask matrix NMS
